items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: Ben Davis was the composer of a lot of music, Benny Davis. He wrote a lot of music for the old Cotton Club.

ctx.x: (Inaudible) Cotton Club Review with dancers and --

Yes, it was the whole thing, just like the old Cotton Club, chorus girls, yeah. So anyway I put this band together and made -- and got the music and made the arrangements. Ben Davis was the composer of a lot of music, Benny Davis. He wrote a lot of music for the old Cotton Club.
And so I started, made these arrangmeents. We had jungle numbers and all this. And so I told the guy, I said,
